subject: general
question: If the radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 17% and its height is increased by 138%, then what is the percentage increase (rounded off to the closest integer) in its volume?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume ∝ r²h

New r = 0.83r ⇒ r² becomes (0.83)² = 0.6889

New h = 2.38h

Net factor = 0.6889 × 2.38 ≈ 1.6396

Increase = (1.6396 − 1) × 100 ≈ 63.96% ≈ 64%

**∴ Answer = 64% increase**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius decreases by 17%, Height increases by 138%

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original volume = πr²h

⇒ New radius = 0.83r

⇒ New height = 2.38h

⇒ New volume = π × (0.83r)² × (2.38h)

⇒ = πr²h × (0.83)² × 2.38

⇒ = Original volume × (0.6889 × 2.38)

⇒ = Original volume × 1.6396

⇒ % increase = (1.6396 − 1) × 100 = 63.96% ≈ 64%

**∴ The correct answer is 64% increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Formula

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Percentage Change Rule

If quantity depends on powers, apply change to each term separately

Compound Effect

Net change = product of individual multipliers

Approximation Trick

Round final answer to nearest integer if required
